instant.$description: State feedback — hover, press, immediate value change.

deliberate.$description: Modal, scrim — blocking surfaces enter slowly.

decel.$description: Enter — decelerate into place. Default for things appearing.

accel.$description: Exit — accelerate away. For things leaving the screen.

standard.$description: Move — on-screen repositioning that starts and ends at rest.

spring.$description: Toggle — slight overshoot for switches, checkmarks.
